name: lemma-lm
description: Syntax highlighting and language server support for Lemma's .lm files, and, experimentally, what saved changes break across repositories

lemma.lmPath.markdownDescription: The `lm` binary. The extension runs `lm lsp` and talks to it over stdio.

lemma.lemmaPath.markdownDescription: The `lemma` binary. With `lemma.checkOnChange.enabled`, the extension runs `lemma check --lsp` and talks to it over stdio.

lemma.checkOnChange.enabled.markdownDescription: Experimental. Runs `lemma check --lsp`, which watches every repository of the workspace and, when a repository's saved files change, checks it as `lemma check --change` would. What the change breaks is shown as problems on the code it breaks, in any repository, and summarized on the changed files.

lemma.checkOnChange.manifest.markdownDescription: The workspace's `mod.lm` for `lemma.checkOnChange.enabled`. By default, the nearest `mod.lm` above the first workspace folder that declares a `workspace`.

lemma.trace.server.description: Logs the messages between VS Code and the Lemma language server to the output panel.

scripts.check: tsc -p . --noEmit && tsc -p test --noEmit && eslint . && prettier --check src test scripts eslint.config.mjs && node scripts/check-grammar.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run package && npm run compile:test && node scripts/integration-test.mjs
